messages:
alex: Morning — async standup. What I did: ran KMS rotation dry-run on staging, opened INC-7745 for key policy mismatch. Blockers: need owner for the role that calls KeyEncrypt. Today: finish KMS policy patch, ping infra for IAM role review.

maddie: FYI I reviewed the dry-run logs, see snippet:
```
aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd1234 --pending-window-in-days 7
...policy mismatch: Principal: service/ecs.amazonaws.com not listed
```
I'll add the missing service principal in the PR.

jia: PRs: #4123 (kms-policy-fix) ready for review, #4125 (audit-scripts) awaiting tests. I'll rebase later today. @kevin can you take a look at #4123? :pray: 

kevin: On it. Will review after standup. Quick note: sec-scan-bot flagged a medium in redwood/console related to open redirect (SEC-2024-19). I'm triaging, but low exploitability.

sec-bot: Automated weekly vuln scan complete. Results: 0 critical, 1 high, 4 medium, 7 low. High: dependency update required (jwt-lib v2.1.0 -> v2.1.3). Link: https://internal.redwood.ai/scans/1890012345

alex: thanks. For the high one, let's schedule a short patch window tonight at 22:00 UTC if green. @maddie @jia OK?

maddie: OK for 22:00 UTC. I'll coordinate with infra for canary deploy.

jia: fine. Blocker for me: can't run local policy linter due to python deps conflict. I've opened a containerized task in GH actions to run it instead (see PR #4125 comments).

kevin: Note on audits: we're due for Q2 KMS access review. I've drafted an email to app owners, will post to #security-ops for approvals.

alex: sounds good. Quick ask: anyone currently owning key "prod-payments-enc"? Need to confirm rotation plan.

maddie: I own that one, will update rotation schedule and add runbook steps.

jia: I'll add tests to ensure new policy doesn't break cross-account decrypt.

kevin: pinging @oncall-sre about potential latency spike during canary at 22:00.

SRE-bot: Noted. We'll watch metrics and set alert thresholds: error-rate>0.5% and token-latency>150ms.

alex: Thanks all. If no blockers by 16:00, I'll merge #4123 and schedule the deploy. Otherwise we'll roll to tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maddie: Running a quick preflight check now, will update thread.

(END)
